parts.text:
Within the House of Daena, research, logistics, rescue missions, and combat operations are underway all at once, while the forces of the rainforest and the desert unite along the same front.
Facing chaotic Ley Lines and an expanding crisis, Sumeru relies on knowledge to coordinate the battle, and decisive action to answer the danger.

#### From Trees to a Forest

**Tighnari:** Phew... It's this late already? I'm going to grab some food. Anyone want anything?

**[Name]:** I'm good.

**Cyno:** A Pita Pocket for me. Get Hat Guy some juice, maybe. Oh, and Sethos headed out to the House of Daena to move some books, so how about a Charcoal-Baked Ajilenakh Cake for him?

**Tighnari:** Okay.

**[Name]:** I know that look. I'm guessing there's been a development?

**Cyno:** To a certain extent. One look at that group, and it's clear there are still a lot of questions we can't answer. But the good news is, we've managed to ascertain the basic properties of the Ley Line anomalies.

**Cyno:** The samples from the desert region are more volatile than the rainforest batch, and their residual reactions are stronger.

**Cyno:** Although they come from an area severely affected by the Hallowing, they can at least be used for standard testing... The Ibis King can rest assured about that.

**[Name]:** Sometimes I forget you graduated from Spantamad with honors. You can have countless other achievements, and still, if you're known for one thing, that's all people are ever going to remember. That's life, I guess.

**Cyno:** Hold on, was that a... compliment? I know things are bad, but this isn't some heart to heart before the end, right?

**[Name]:** ...You wish. I'm leaving as soon as Sethos gets back. You and Tighnari can have the juice.

**Tighnari:** It's for you. Here. Can't go to Natlan's aid on an empty stomach.

**[Name]:** You know full well I don't need... Fine. It's actually pretty good. Not too sweet.

**Tighnari:** I've heard things are even worse over there. Don't you think you and Sethos should bring a few more people?

**Tighnari:** Rahman mentioned that if the Corps of Thirty is short on people, he can spare a few.

**[Name]:** It's fine. If we run into problems, we'll deal with them.

**Kaveh:** Everyone, ready your terminals... How's that? Do you read me?

**Tighnari:** Loud and clear. Once you're done setting up the Akasha Terminals, come down and take a break. I brought some snacks.

**Alhaitham:** All communications are in place. I assume some sort of speech is soon to follow.

**Kaveh:** The Dendro Archon put you in charge, right, Cyno? Well, the floor is yours.

**Sethos:** Ohoho, looks like I'm just in time. Let's hear what our commander has to say at a time like this!

**[Name]:** There's flatbread. Want some?

**Sethos:** Oh, sweet. Thanks.

**Alhaitham:** I'll have a coffee.

**Kaveh:** Working on it... Hold on, I'm not your personal barista!

**Tighnari:** Shh... It's time.

**Cyno:** Ahem. Everyone, I am General Mahamatra Cyno. I am relaying this message to you from the House of Daena.

**Cyno:** While the Dendro Archon and Grand Sage Naphis are occupied, I will be coordinating operations in the Sumeru region in their stead.

**Cyno:** To anyone receiving this transmission, please proceed according to your previously issued orders.

**Cyno:** This operation is divided into four main areas: battlefield coordination, research data integration, forest search and rescue, and monster eradication.

**Cyno:** Furthermore, with Natlan so severely affected by this crisis, Sumeru is also dispatching a team there to provide support.

**Cyno:** Another team of researchers, stationed at the House of Daena, will continue looking into the various anomalies that have been occurring recently. Their findings will be shared with the other nations as soon as possible.

**Cyno:** Should anyone make any relevant discoveries, be sure to report them immediately.

**Cyno:** The Akasha system will remain active for the duration of the operation. Supported by the power of the Three Kings, the Pari, and the Aranara, our communications network will cover Sumeru in its entirety.

**Cyno:** The situation is dire, but Sumeru is the Nation of Wisdom. We have weathered countless hardships and continue to stand firm, and this time will be no different. Final victory will be ours.

**Cyno:** Well then, let the operation commence.
